scopeLabel: ASUS Japan Vivobook product catalog filtered to 2026 manufacturer-listed Vivobook family including the creator-labeled Vivobook Pro model

models: ASUS Vivobook S16 (S5608, Snapdragon); Copilot+ PC
ASUS Vivobook S14 (S5408, Snapdragon); Copilot+ PC
universe.populationMethod: ASUS official ProductList API /recent-data/apiv2/SeriesFilterResult with two non-overlapping pages (20+15), and independent PageSize=100 corroboration. The manufacturer metadata TotalCount is 35 as of 2026-10-31, not stale search-index count 33 nor the first page 20.

officialProducts.model: ASUS Vivobook S16 (S5608, Snapdragon); Copilot+ PC
ASUS Vivobook S14 (S5408, Snapdragon); Copilot+ PC

universe.notes: Products from both manufacturer ProductList pages are retained, including one creator-category Vivobook Pro manufacturer-listed within the selected Vivobook series. The exact family-code, manufacturer product ID and product URL form the locked universe; listing labels may contain marketing taglines not usable as SKU equivalence. Actual support/manual URLs are candidates until live model-specific proof; selected variant code must be disclosed. 2026-10-31 live review run 41213023329 re-captured 35/35 exact source model, product ID and URL identities from two 20+15 manufacturer API pages and 100-result cross-check. Secondary manufacturer-selected variant discovery (global helpdesk model selector and alternate exact M1605YA official product page) found 35 distinct manufacturer model-specific operational manual indices. Positive HTML manual section, actual English user manual, 34 Japanese user manual listings, selected variant and edition/download metadata were validated for all; zero held. The X1607QA/X1407QA family title uses the manufacturer-shortened Q code but exact full QA variant is explicitly selected and product source identifies the full QA model.

review.notes: All 35 model-specific user manual list paths are candidates until source-linked identity, final manufacturer HTTPS destination, displayed selected variant and actual Japanese/English user manual metadata are positively verified. No inference that variants within one marketed family use interchangeable manuals.

liveReview.secondaryFindings: ASUS model selector supplied model-specific codes; M1605YA official alternate global Vivobook 16 OLED M1605 manual positively verified; manufacturer shortens X1607QA/X1407QA family page title but exact QA selected variant documented.
